messages.snippet: Eleanor, Dan, I'm pleased to confirm that Project Quartz completed at 12:48 today. Ardenfield Quartz
messages.subject: Project Quartz - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor, Dan,

I'm pleased to confirm that Project Quartz completed at 12:48 today. Ardenfield Quartz Bidco now owns 100% of Whitmore Thermal Components. The £35.25m completion payment and £1.5m retention have been paid, the W&I policy has incepted and the furnace lease has been redeemed. Deferred consideration of £2.0m falls due on 13 February 2027.

Congratulations to the team. We'll circulate the completion bible and the post-completion filings (SH01/SDRT, PSC updates) next week.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
